cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Consequences Compound
cards.instruction: Make each new choice carry a larger reward, cost, audience, or point of no return.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've signed below you. Our table-tennis game decides who cleans up tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I signed for a borrowed bat. That's the equipment book.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, putting commitments in writing. Loser cleans for the whole month; enter that beside the bats.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm returning mine at six, when the club meets. I haven't agreed to your bet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll settle the terms at six in front of the club. If you agree there, everyone gets to hold us to the month.

reason: Replace the generic confidence prefaces with a specific misunderstood copied action whose correction shapes the Drive, keeping each alternative a different negotiation with B.
